Fitted values

Source: R/fitted.R
fitted.kb_fit.Rd

Posterior medians of the expected response at each observed row, matching augment()'s fitted column: wet weight (kg) for weight fits, plant diameter (mm) for size fits, the dry:wet ratio for wet/dry fits, the carbon or nitrogen fraction of dry mass for carbon or nitrogen fits, and wet biomass (kg/m²) for cover calibration fits. For the full posterior, use posterior_epred().

Usage

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
fitted(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A kb_fit object.

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

Value

A numeric vector of fitted values on the response scale, length nobs(object).

See also

residuals() for deviance residuals, augment(), and posterior_epred() for the full posterior.

Other fit methods: augment.kb_fit(), coef.kb_fit(), glance.kb_fit(), kb_model_describe(), kb_samples(), kb_stancode(), log_lik.kb_fit(), posterior_epred.kb_fit(), posterior_linpred.kb_fit(), posterior_predict.kb_fit(), prior_summary.kb_fit(), residuals.kb_fit(), summary.kb_fit(), tidy.kb_fit()

Examples

fitted(fit_weight_sim_nereo)
